FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Vitality Health & Nutrition, we specialize in retailing a variety of health products sourced exclusively from verified suppliers. Our operations prioritize customer safety and product integrity, ensuring rigorous safety practices for product storage, handling, and display. We maintain clear and compliant health claims in accordance with FDA and FTC guidelines, and all products undergo regular inventory audits to eliminate expired or recalled items. Our knowledgeable staff is trained to answer health-related inquiries and promptly resolve customer complaints, cultivating a trustworthy shopping environment. Additionally, we implement robust security measures for both in-store and online transactions to protect customer data. With proper business licensing and adherence to regulatory standards, we uphold the highest standards of quality and compliance in the health food retail industry.
